finding_and_reconciled_evidence.classification: Existing 774 historical native source finding, independently re-assessed; no new accepted unique count.
finding_and_reconciled_evidence.first_contract: A dispatch built from an admitted integer instance capacity must cover the supported capacity after float conversion, ceiling and grid folding.
trace: The native generic node reads public page.compute_capacity, converts it to f32, divides by 64 and rounds up; above 65535 groups it folds into x=65535 and y=ceil(groups/65535), also using f32.

The already recorded ROOT-INITIAL04-F053 symbolic witness is 20,971,201 = 64*(65535*5)+1. Under nearest-even f32 conversion it rounds to 20,971,200, so the node computes 327,675 groups and the folded grid is 65535 by 5: 20,971,200 invocations, one short of the input population. No numerical program, buffer, input, test or dispatch was constructed or executed.

The default backend selects PagedAllocator with nominal page_size 1,000,000, while page_size and public page.compute_capacity can be changed or a custom backend supplied. If the offset allocator preserves its advertised page bound and normal ownership, the default page does not reach this witness; the offset allocator implementation and all producers were not inspected in this assignment.
conditions: The source-level numeric witness requires a supported accepted capacity at that magnitude, ready pipeline/bind groups, suitable memory/device limits, actual node execution and a consumer requiring one invocation per instance; none was demonstrated. Exact shader indexing and any visible/runtime effect are uninspected.

Under old 6533 source, the generic native plugin is registered for shrub bark and leaf materials, and their generated understory entities carry GpuCullCompute. This establishes direct historical first-party wiring, not that the large witness is reached or the pipeline runs.

Tactical grass uses a separately registered per-view Rust culling function with its own reset followed by select and integer div_ceil scheduling. Therefore generic node absence of a reset is not itself evidence that the old grass per-view reset is missing. Current 95e grass and dependencies differ.

Do not prescribe editing an unused historical dependency.
finding_and_reconciled_evidence.acceptance: Every supported successful dispatch covers the admitted population under actual indexing and target limits, or rejects unsupported capacity before submission. Per-view reset and legitimate asynchronous readiness retain explicit contracts.

nonfindings: The node returns before launching when pipeline, cache, allocator or global cull buffer is unavailable and skips zero-capacity/missing bind-group pages. Whether this temporary absence is acceptable to any actual capture/readiness policy remains open.
The node calls set_pipeline and binds the retained page groups; these source statements do not prove buffer initialization, shader behavior, per-view camera semantics or device execution.
The native plugin schedules the generic node before camera_driver; that is not a proof that it runs once per camera or that its retained buffers are reset by some other system.
The separately shown old grass adapter requests a per-view camera and orders reset before select; this fact does not establish generic shrub reset, all camera graph behavior or render output.
The 1,000,000 default page size is a relevant narrowing condition, not a universal bound on public fields, custom backends or externally manipulated state.
open_questions: Do any supported historical shrub/generic applications configure an accepted page at the F053 size, and what are actual allocation and device constraints?
Does the generic native producer use appropriate view-specific state, reset and scheduling for each supported camera and shadow mode? No WGSL or native runtime semantics were newly inspected.
Which remaining 95e owner replaces historical grass/shrub behavior, and does it have an analogous integer capacity/grid obligation?
Do pipeline readiness or missing resources lead to an intentional unavailable visual frame or require retained error/status?
How do F053, upstream count narrowing, page reuse/clears and native binding lifetimes relate without merging distinct first failures or duplicate counts?
